scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and standalone numerical reproduction. Common Nyström, Gaussian chi-square, beta and preconditioner components acknowledged as established; bibliographic overlap remains possible.

title: Exact Gaussian improvement probabilities and quartic-root thresholds for a one-probe Nyström spectral preconditioner
